title: CFD Engineer
description: Run and interpret CFD on the wings, floor and sidepod inlets, and turn the results into geometry the manufacturing team can actually build.
lookingFor: Willingness to learn a solver from scratch — we will teach you
Patience with meshes that will not converge
Any exposure to fluid mechanics coursework

title: Composites Manufacturing
description: Layup, cure and finish the monocoque and bodywork. This is hands-on workshop work with real hours in the composites lab.
lookingFor: Comfortable working with your hands and with PPE
Reliable attendance — layup cannot be paused
No prior composites experience required

title: Powertrain Calibration
description: Work on the engine map, cooling package and fuel system, and take the car through dyno testing.
lookingFor: Interest in control systems or thermodynamics
Methodical about recording test data
Willing to be in the workshop on dyno days

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description: Build the telemetry stack, the dashboard and the wiring loom logic. Everything from CAN bus to the driver display.
lookingFor: Any C, C++ or Python — we do not expect embedded experience
Interest in real-time systems
Happy to debug hardware, not just code

title: Suspension Design Engineer
description: Own the kinematics, the uprights and the damper package, and validate the model against what the car actually does on track.
lookingFor: CAD ability, or the willingness to get there quickly
Interest in vehicle dynamics
Comfortable defending a design decision with data

title: Sponsorship & Partnerships
description: Find partners, write the proposals, and keep the relationships alive across the season. You will be the reason the car gets built.
lookingFor: Comfortable writing to people you have never met
Organised enough to track a pipeline
Any degree — business, engineering, sciences, all welcome

title: Marketing & Media
description: Run our social channels, shoot and edit content in the workshop and at competition, and build the story sponsors are buying into.
lookingFor: Photography, video or design skill — show us anything you have made
An eye for what is worth filming
No engineering background needed

title: Cost & Operations Analyst
description: Own the Cost Report — one of the three static events scored at Silverstone — and keep the season budget honest.
lookingFor: Comfortable in a spreadsheet
Precise about detail; the cost event is judged on it
Finance, economics or business students especially welcome
